critical_code_review_comments: Footer 'политика приватности' link points to #map (since privacy block is merged inside the map section). Anchor lands at top of map section, not directly on the privacy block — minor UX nit. If desired, give the privacy block its own anchor (e.g., #sigillum) and update footer href.
App.js is ~620 lines and growing — consider splitting Manifesto/Reading/FAQ content into separate files for maintainability (recommended over 700-line threshold).

ReadingArticle uses static data-testid='reading-article' for all 4 articles (not indexed). Fine for count assertions, but if future tests need per-article targeting, append index (e.g., reading-article-0).
Native <details>/<summary> for FAQ is excellent — accessible, no JS state needed, animation via CSS class. Good pattern.
Mobile menu max-h-[520px] accommodates 5 nav links + CTA correctly at 390px viewport.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (61/61 functional assertions; the 1 raw FAIL was a test-script artifact comparing case-sensitive text against CSS-uppercased rendered text)
